rules.description: A student is eligible for this category if they are an existing scholarship recipient and continue in 2017-18 in the same scheme and same school/institute.
rules.condition: Student is an existing scholarship recipient and continues in 2017-18 in the same scheme and same school/institute.
rules.outcome: Student will be considered eligible in this category.
rules.evidence_quote: A student will be considered eligible in this category if he/she is an existing scholarship recipient and continues in 2017-18, in the same scheme and in the same school/institute.
